Nav.refillTitle: Top-up coming soon — payments are not open yet

Home.metaTitle: Taurge — From raw to translated page, bubble by bubble
Home.subtitle: Taurge does the repetitive work — spotting bubbles, reading text, drafting translations, erasing — so you spend your time where it matters: tone, rhythm, the perfect line.
Home.pipelineIntro: Every step is visible, reversible, and keeps you in control before moving to the next one.

steps.title: Import
steps.body: A chapter PDF or page images. 50 MB max.

steps.title: Pages
steps.body: The PDF is split into numbered pages, ready to read.

steps.title: OCR
steps.body: Each bubble is located, its text extracted with a confidence score.

steps.title: Translation
steps.body: An automatic first draft, block by block.

steps.title: Proofreading
steps.body: You fix the original and the translation, bubble by bubble.

steps.title: Cleaning + export
steps.body: Bubbles erased, ZIP ready for lettering.

features: Automatic translation, editable block by block
ZIP export: cleaned pages + texts as JSON
Home.notYetBody: Automatic lettering, hand-drawn SFX detection and team workflows are coming later. Taurge prepares the page; final lettering stays in your usual tool.
Home.footerTagline: Built for translators, not to replace them.

Billing.title: Subscription and usage
Billing.hypothesis: Pricing under test — paid subscriptions are not open yet.
Billing.howItWorks: 1 credit = 1 page processed per action (OCR reading, translation or cleaning). Credits are charged only after a successful job.
Billing.creator: Creator
Billing.freeDesc: To discover Taurge and try the localization flow on a small project.
Billing.creatorDesc: For independent translators who work regularly.
Billing.teamDesc: For a small translation team. Billed per workspace.
Billing.studioDesc: For studios with larger volumes and support needs.

free: Up to 20 OCR pages per month
Up to 10,000 translated characters per month
creator: Up to 5 active projects
Up to 200 OCR pages per month
Up to 100,000 translated characters per month
2 GB storage
Per-project glossary
ZIP, CBZ or PDF export
Usage history
team: Up to 600 OCR pages per month for the workspace
Up to 300,000 translated characters per month
studio: Quotas and storage defined by your needs
Terms and integrations discussed before subscribing

Billing.compareNote: Price per workspace, per month. Quotas renew every month. These are pricing hypotheses: they are not enforced automatically yet — only the credit meter below applies today.
Billing.quotasNotEnforced: Indicative quotas, not enforced automatically yet.

Legal.cookieBody: We use cookies required for the site to work. Only with your consent, Vercel Analytics measures traffic anonymously. Refusing changes nothing to how Taurge works.
Legal.deleteAccountBody: Permanent deletion: account, projects, uploaded files, glossaries, usage history and transactions. This cannot be undone.
